title: Number of Provinces
statement: isConnected is an adjacency matrix over n cities, where entry [i][j] is 1 when city i and city j are directly connected. A province is a maximal group of cities all reachable from each other. Return how many provinces there are.
constraints: the matrix is symmetric with 1s on the diagonal
hints: This is counting connected components, the same shape as Number of Islands but on an explicit graph.
Keep a visited array. For each unvisited city, increment the counter and flood everything reachable from it.
Union-Find also solves it neatly: union every connected pair, then count distinct roots.
